title: A variable contains the whole object
statement: An object variable contains the object itself, not a reference to it, so every variable is its own object and passing it around passes the object.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: draw or describe memory after two variables refer to one object
evidence_patterns.signature: draws two separate objects, one inside each variable

example.item:
p = Point(1, 2)
q = p
Draw p and q.
example.expected: Two variables, both pointing to one Point object
example.response: Two boxes, each containing a Point(1, 2)

evidence_patterns.item_shape: predict identity comparison of two variables assigned from one another

example.item:
p = Point(1, 2)
q = p
print(p is q)

discriminators.vs_slip: Diagnosed by the drawing or by identity questions; the model is consistent. A slip is a single wrong prediction with a correct drawing.

vs.prog.obj.assignment-copies-object: Assignment-copies is the behavioural prediction; this record is the memory model behind it. Use the drawing task to separate learners who know about references but think assignment copies from those with no reference concept.

conflicts_with.label: An object variable holds a reference; assignment copies the reference

resolved_by.label: An object variable holds a reference; assignment copies the reference
